annotations.title: TIA — instantiate block from master copy

description: Creates a PLC block from a master copy of the open project's library (name from tia_library_mastercopies) and returns the new block's name. The master copy must hold PLC blocks: one that holds hardware and no block — e.g. a device master copy, the only kind tia_library_mastercopy_create makes — is refused with 409 kind:"mastercopy_not_blocks" by serves after app 1.6.3 (up to 1.6.3: 500 "Copying from the library failed"); other non-block content (a UDT or tag-table copy) still fails inside Openness. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/blocks/frommastercopy {masterCopy}. Class M-off.
